svg.text: M-21n : U1 / V1 / W1 (Δ links fitted)
daisy chain, drain to SG one end
CABLE SCHEDULE (W-M21n.1 and W-C21n: same for n = 2..9)
SETTING (GS21 parameter names; confirm numbers in the GS21 manual)
reverse packs powder at the drive end
quiet; derate check OK at 0.25 kW
read on fault; reset after the cause is cleared
1. Bridging / empty bin: the MES compares the weight gain per second with the setpoint; if < 30 % for 5 s at fast speed the feeder stops and alarms 'no flow B0n'.
2. Over-torque: output current > 1.2 A for 2 s = plug at the discharge or a foreign object; stop, alarm, no auto-restart.
3. After any fault the operator must confirm on the HMI; the screw is enclosed so no guard interlock is needed (tail cap = fixed guard, tool required).
